title: Compilation Result v1
description: Structural schema for a conceptual CompilationResult. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/171-compilation-result-model.md for the exact CURRENT/PARTIAL/PLANNED status of every field, mapped to the real GenerateResponse/ModelRecord/GeneratedModel shapes.

compilationId.description: PLANNED — the current modelId (= definitionHash) serves a similar purpose but is not a distinct per-attempt compilation identifier.

compilerVersion.description: PLANNED as a distinct concept — see docs/bible/08-alchemist/182-compiler-versioning.md; no compiler-specific version constant currently exists separate from GENERATOR_VERSION.

forgeRuleSetVersion.description: PARTIAL — every Forge rule is individually versioned (specs/forge/v1/current-rule-registry.json) but no single aggregate rule-set version exists.

kernelVersion.description: PLANNED — CadQuery/OpenCascade version is never recorded on any generated model; see docs/bible/07-atlas/137-determinism-and-reproducibility.md.

normalizedDefinition.description: CURRENT: the JewelryDefinition instance itself, post-Pydantic-defaulting.

geometryPlanSummary.description: PLANNED — no GeometryPlan exists to summarize.

diagnostics.description: CURRENT (as ValidationResult list) + PARTIAL (compiler-level diagnostics per compiler-diagnostic.schema.json don't exist as a distinct list today).

artifacts.description: PARTIAL — each artifact is generated on-demand by a separate HTTP call today, not aggregated into one manifest returned by compilation itself.

fallbacks.description: CURRENT: a subset of GeneratedModel.warnings, not a distinct structured list.

cacheStatus.description: PARTIAL — ModelService's cache behavior exists, but no field surfaces hit/miss/evicted status to the API caller today.
